title: Triple-Threat Footwork Reps
description: Players rehearse the triple-threat position on every catch — ball ready to shoot, pass or drive — before adding any live decision-making.

content.objective: Land in a strong, balanced triple-threat position on every catch, ready for any of the three options.
content.setup: Each player has a ball and simulates a catch facing the basket.
instructions: Toss the ball up slightly, catch it, and land in a low, balanced triple-threat stance.
Protect the ball on the side nearest an imaginary defender.
Front pivot once, then reverse pivot once, staying in the stance throughout.
Finish with a jab step in each direction before resetting.
coachingPoints: Keep the knees bent and the ball at hip height, ready to move in any direction.
Keep the head up throughout every pivot.
Protect the ball with the off-hand and forearm at all times.
commonMistakes: Standing too tall in the triple-threat stance.
Exposing the ball on the side a defender would be.
Letting the feet settle flat instead of staying on the balls of the feet.
content.safety: Leave enough space between players for free pivoting.
